en: The streets are quiet and nearly empty.
A dull sky hangs over the street.

A dull sky hangs
over the street.

"Dressed like that... You must be
headed into the labyrinth."

"The labyrinth is a precious relic.
Take care not to damage it."

"This land is full of ancient ruins.
Forgotten truths may sleep there."
"It will take a long time to study them all."

"You're still alive.
You have a fine sword arm."

"The labyrinth is the oldest relic here.
But the royal house keeps it for itself."
"You cannot imagine the harm it does."

"The murals in the labyrinth...
They stand for the royal house
of Rikistria."

"Murals, folk songs...
The royal history is fascinating."

"If it interests you, have a listen.
To the song you always hear from the tavern."

"The murals seem to carry
a magical meaning."

"For what purpose, I wonder...
There is more to study."

"I need a little money.
Will you buy an item I found in the labyrinth?"

"I can't say what it is.
Shall we say 400G?"

"Will you buy it?
The price is 400G."

"I studied them again.
The murals are centuries old."

"Yet they show the rise and fall of Rikistria.
Who could have painted them?"

"I have thought it over.
I believe the murals are a kind of prophecy."

"With the old folk songs of this land in mind,
that is the only sensible view."

"I can say no more without seeing them,
but it is not worth dying for."

"Had the king not claimed the ruins,
we could have studied them freely..."

"That tablet I sold you...
It seems the old people used it in magic."

"The texts say it is a special object
used in traps and seals."
"What could they have used it for?"

"Oh, the tablet was useful to you?
Well, well."

"Oh dear.
You seem to be short of money."

"Earthquake after earthquake.
The labyrinth keeps changing."
"An uneasy air hangs over the town..."

"What is happening down there,
deep in the labyrinth..."

"Thanks for the other day.
Dad's been home since he got back,
so we're together all the time."

"Oh, meet my friend.
We made friends down in the cellar there."

"He comes out to play sometimes,
but I think he lives down there."

"Can I ask you a favor?
He likes to bury things in the dirt,
and he hid something special of mine."

"I looked, but I can't find it...
Will you tell me if you find it?
It's a small, pretty ring..."

"Thank you.
I won't lose it again."

"He looks sorry too,
so I'll forgive him."
"Tell me if you find my ring."

"Running a place like this,
you see who lives and who dies.
I can see it for you too..."

"My daughter worked hard while I was away.
I'll lean on her a little longer."

"They say monsters tried to get out.
It was supposed to be over. Why..."
"So you still go to the labyrinth."

"Then take this with you.
I have no more use for it."
"If you don't need anything, leave me be."

You may be good with a sword,
but don't push your luck.

Damn... I shouldn't have gambled...
How do I pay for tonight...

"I see.
Ask me when you feel like it."

"You're exploring the labyrinth, I hear.
Will you do me a favor?"

"A soldier ran up a big tab here.
He was moved from outside to inside.
I want my money before he gets killed."

"I'll pay you 1000G.
He's on the second floor down.
Easy work for someone like you."

"Did you find that soldier?
Make it quick, please."

"So this is instead of the money.
Barely covers the tab...
Here, your reward as promised."

"Now that your purse is full,
how about a game?"

"You've got no money.
Some other time."

"Are you any good at poker?
Will you play a hand with me?"

"With me, three of a kind or less loses,
but anything better pays a lot more.
What do you say?"

"No money,
and you want to bet?"

"Want to bet 10000G
on a game of blackjack with me?"

"Well, another 10000G
on a game of blackjack?"

"Your bag looks full.
Talk to me later."
"Hey, you can't pay for a room."

"I heard you killed the king.
Good, you avenged your friends."

"More people are dying down there lately.
Run if it gets dangerous."

You reach the labyrinth entrance.
A guard stands there, bored.

Haven't seen you before.

A customer...

"Haven't seen you before.
It's dangerous for amateurs."

"You, the tavern owner...
Why would anyone go into that place?"

"I just watch for monsters coming out.
Go in if you want."
"I hear you killed the king of Rikistria."

"I'll be back in the capital soon.
Thanks to you."

"Even a fighter like you
can't do anything about it?"

"You a mercenary?
Don't look at me like that."

"Too bad.
The others all went to the labyrinth."

"I'm too fat,
so I'm not going."

"That kid comes here every day now.
He's looking for his missing father."

"He should eat something...
I've never seen him eat."

"Quiet today without the kid.
Maybe he went to the labyrinth again."

"He kept talking about his father lately.
Maybe he went into the labyrinth."

"Haven't seen the kid in a while.
Maybe he died down there."
"I wonder what his last meal was..."

"...You go to the labyrinth, right?
Did you see two men, one old, one young?"

"A soldier said something about them,
but I've been in town the whole time.
Not that I want to meet them."

"The owner seems to be gone.
No one else has noticed,
but the food is worse some days."
"I have a big belly and a big heart. I eat it all."

"The owner still isn't back.
I've worried myself thin.
I need to eat more..."

"The daughter's cooking isn't getting better.
Then again, food is food once it's eaten."

"The owner is back, but the food is the same.
Doesn't the owner cook?"

"I don't care about the owner now.
The food is finally edible."

"You again...
Do you want to join us?"

"Too bad.
The others all went to the labyrinth."

"A soldier said something about them,
but I've been in town the whole time.
Not that I want to meet them."

"...You go to the labyrinth, right?
Did you see two men, one old, one young?"

"In the labyrinth you can't eat
what you want."

"Oh, no parents,
so no money for food."

"New face... no, wait...
You're the one who wouldn't die."

"Survivors of a mercenary band killed my men.
Now it's their turn to die."

"You don't want to see their bodies.
Stay here."
First there was a great power

Three gods came from it.
Two grew weary and returned to heaven.
One gave life to this land.

The Earth Mother
grieved at the warring lives

To calm them
she tore her body in two

From her came
a white dragon and a black.
All life knelt before them.

But what irony,
the two dragons fought

And the earth's grief
never ended

The tears of the earth
sleep deep below

A monster hid in the army,
hiding that it was not human

A drop of the sea saw through it,
and more so as it became king

To the king's tomb where dragons dwell
a youth went to find his father

In that land of monsters
he found white bones.
Only a sword was left.

The sword shone and drove off evil.
The youth became lord of the land.
The sword became its guarding light.

The people cheered,
their cries filled the land

A cursed isle, a cursed king
stole the sword and called evil

A youth, for his friend,
sought the sword

The black dragon behind the king
called the youth with a sword

The white dragon behind the youth
gave the youth a sword

The youth cut down the black dragon
and came home with two swords.
The cursed king lies under the isle.

The white dragon ruled the king
and broke the shining sword

His friend's life checked the king
and sealed the mad king away

A young child of royal blood
took a sword against his father

The white dragon hated the royal blood
and sent the father against the child

The bond of blood will not break.
The sword shone again.
The child met his fate.

The two dragons rest together,
but the earth's tears never dry

The crown that makes a king
a king, whether
it takes form or not

He rode the land, his hunger endless.
He took all and held all.
The holy labyrinth was his vault.

A dark power no man should have.
The land burned to ash.
The work of the king's brow.

The people rose in fear.
The king fled to his vault.

The king of the land is gone,
but the king below never sleeps

"No?
Ask me if you change your mind."
"Ask me if you want to hear more."

"Sorry, I'm busy now.
Let's talk another time."

"We're this busy, and Mother goes off
to visit a grave... Leaving me
the shop. Come back soon..."

"You go to the labyrinth, right?
Have you seen my mother?"

"Mother went to the labyrinth and isn't back.
She goes there all the time, so she's fine,
but a lot is going on lately."

"Such a bad habit.
Visiting a grave
won't bring anyone back."
"If you see her, tell her to hurry home."

"Mother hasn't come back.
If you see her, please tell her
to hurry home."

"Mother is back.
I had almost given up..."

"She said you helped her.
Thank you."

"They say you beat the king.
You're the hero of the town."

"This is my thanks.
It was my father's, I think,
but you saved my mother."

"We never had earthquakes before...
Isn't it peaceful now?"

"A lot of regulars stopped coming,
but I'll keep the shop open.
I can't close Mother's place."

"Oh, your bag is full.
Make some room and come back."

"You go to the labyrinth, right?
Please take this."

"A soldier left it.
He thought it was Mother's."

"If you see her down there, give it to her.
I'm sure she needs it..."

"...Mister,
you go down there, don't you?"

"Well... um...
My dad went missing down there...
...and..."
"...I want you to find my dad."

"...Dad went in there for work
and never came back...
I tried to look for him..."

"Dad liked to drink here.
I thought he might be here,
but he isn't today."

"Thanks to you,
I made it home."

"My son came to the tavern every day.
It seems he worried everyone."

"He's doing well now.
This is our thanks."

"I'm done with grave robbing.
I'll find honest work."

"I can't put my son
in danger again."

"Until the monsters leave the labyrinth,
I'll look for other work."
"Oh, your bag seems to be full."
"Make some room and come back for it."

"Have you used the Crystal Bottle?
It holds spring water. Very handy."

"Oh, yes.
It's a small thing, but
I left you another gift."

"It's by the spring. Take it with you.
I have no use for it, so don't be shy."

"A while back,
a man who said he survived a mercenary band
paid me 10000G to pass on a message..."

"'Pray for our comrades...
The lieutenant is not himself.'"

"You were lucky.
He picked an honest man like me.
Mind you, I lost the letter..."

"I see.
You'd trample on his wishes.
That's the kind of man you are."

"If you want to hear it,
bring 10000G."

"You're carrying too much to take it.
Clear some room first."

"So you're the mercenary I've heard about.
Going into the labyrinth, eh?
Want a tip?"
"There are lots of secret rooms down there."

"Next to a trap warning on a wall, say.
They say there's a room with the king's treasure."

"The wall next to the warning.
Search it and you'll see."

"The chest was empty?
Why would I tell a stranger
where treasure is?"

"Don't believe everything you hear.
Good lesson, eh?"

"What?
Take it up with the king."

"What, a hidden door?
Oh, yes, that's it.
Just like I said..."

"I was on guard at the post, I think,
on the floor below that, when I saw an elf.
It went further down with a mage."

"There was a quake a while back, right?
A first for this region, they say.
Maybe it's a sign of something..."

"The small tremors won't stop.
I want out of this creepy town."

"Now I can go back to the capital.
It's been a long time..."

"Endless quakes.
Monsters gone wild.
I may die before I get home..."
"Hey. Did you meet that odd pair too?"

"That sorcerer acts like he sees right
through you. I don't trust his kind."

"And his swordsman.
He'd have attacked if ordered to."

"And that bundle he carried...
This won't be boring."

"A sword, or a staff...
Either way, worth a lot."

"You saved me some work.
The king is gone, the town will be at peace.
All good news."

"That's it for the job.
Now I do this for fun."
"You go to the labyrinth too, I hear."

"Dressed like that? Bold of you...
Well, do your best."

"What?
If you want nothing, leave me be."

"The Plunderer King's labyrinth...
An interesting place to work."

"I'd like to take the king's head soon
and search every corner."

"Are you any good with a bow?
I have a favor to ask."

"There is a place where countless blades
block the device that locks a drawbridge."

"I think an arrow could set it off,
but I'm no good at that sort of thing."
"I'll pay you. I'm counting on you."

"A bow...
Lots of flying monsters there.
Maybe I should practice too."

"Tell me when the bridge is down.
I'll reward you."

"So you came back here.
I was looking for you."

"I checked the drawbridge.
You're quite good."

"I searched the labyrinth,
but found nothing worth much."

"I hear you attack people down there."

"I'd rather not sell to a thug
who turns his blade on anyone."

"The king gave those to his guard.
Did someone hand it to you?"

"They say the king's hall hides arms
for the one the king chooses."

"The soldiers talk.
The monsters below have gone wild."

"I hear there are flying monsters down there.
They attack from high up, out of reach."

"I've started to sell bows.

"You'll need arrows, of course,
and I sell those too.
Restock here."

"Someone from the labyrinth
sold me something rare."

"You'd know what it's worth.
Buy it if you like it."

"The guard says the monsters

"Your bag is full.
Clear some room first."

"The town is restless.
Even the craftsmen's hands shake."

"Quake after quake.
What is happening in the labyrinth..."

"But don't worry.
I'll forge your weapons.
Quake or no quake, I do my job."

"Who are you?
This furnace feeds the flames in the passage.
...You want the flames out too?"

"See the handle? Turn it right to close the
furnace and kill the flames.
...If you can work out how to turn it."

"The handle is scalding.
Hold it too long and you'll get worse than burns.
Want to try?"

"The flames in the passage are out.
Whether they stay out while you pass... who knows."

"Wise choice.
Now, you're in my way."

"I hear you were in that ruined mercenary band.
The town talks.
So you're going to look for your comrades."

"I came from the north on a mission.
This was the Plunderer King's treasure vault.
What I seek must be here."

"The labyrinth is full of danger.
Take care."

"I pray you find your comrades.
I'll go on into the labyrinth first."

"What brings you here?
Your comrades are gone."

"If you stay in the labyrinth,
I must cut you down like this one."

"Go back to town.
My last order as your lieutenant."
"...If you can make it out alive."
Give up the item you found?

"If you stay in the labyrinth,
I will have to remove you."

"You are after that man, I take it.
Could you be the survivor I heard of?"

"Then hurry. That man is bound by the king's curse.
The longer you wait, the more
he sins against his will."

"The quickest way to save him is to kill the king.
But the king is deep in the labyrinth."

"A king drowned in evil, driven out by his people.
Shut in the labyrinth so long, what does he feel?
I would like to ask him myself."

"I will take it as a lesson:
never fall under an evil power's spell."

"A king who took innocent lives without end.
The people are still bound by fear."

"I ask this of you.
Give the people of the town peace."

"It will help you in the king's castle.
You may be the one to slay him..."

"There is a sword there.
Use it."
"It belonged to a knight who died facing the king."

"You opened the door?
To come this far, you must be skilled.
I'll ask you as a first-rate mercenary."

"A king gave me his orders in person:
recover two holy swords stolen from his land."

"They are only swords now,
but someone may yet use them for evil."

"Bring them back safely and you'll be well paid.
Keep it in mind."

"We came to see the fallen king,
but judging by his soldiers, he may be a small man."

"So he has no qualms about chaos.
Age makes him hasty, too."

"Before the king in the labyrinth changes his mind,
I would like him to rot here."

"So you came this far.
My last order was wasted."

"Listen well.
The king took up the sword
to end all strife."

"You are...
No, just an intruder who cannot
see the king's heart..."

"Even with evil power,
the world will be united,
and ruled so strife is never born."

"And with the power of a united world,
that evil will be destroyed."

"Needless deaths must be avoided.
But some deaths are necessary."

"A fool who knows nothing
of so noble a will."

"A necessary death.
Learn it in your own flesh."

"So you have come at last.
The murals' prophecy was not a lie."

"But you, errand boy of an old man,
by what will do you seek to kill me?"

"I rule a nation.
I have not fallen so low that a jester can kill me."

"The work of those who stole
our nation's treasures, the two holy swords."

"The labyrinth and Traujito are in danger.
I must hurry on.
Take great care yourself."

"This man took the one I loved most.
What does he think, sleeping in this dark place?"

"Now he too
can surely rest in peace..."

"...I'll go back to town.
Thank you."

"The old sorcerer's foul power.
The sword in the dark elf's hand.
All of it was right in front of me..."

"They carved a strange magic circle into the ground
and went on into the depths of the labyrinth."

"I tried to stop them.
And this is how I ended up."

"They can't have gone far.
Go after them."

loyal to the king it has taken form again."

"The head of the one who ended your hopes.

"The crystal of light in the

"It is not for you humans to hold."

"Here and now,
my sword will destroy you."

"Your task was only to kill the king.
Why stand before me now?"

"The crystal's power will feed me.
Human, vanish at my whim."

"Trouble again...
Give him this medicine and tell him to walk back."

"You're a warrior, aren't you?
There's plenty of good gear here.
It's the Plunderer King's vault, after all."

"I'm a trader by trade.
I ask the soldiers
about anything good that turns up."

"Do you know of the holy swords of Verdite?
They seem to have gone missing."

"Nothing official,
but there are all sorts of rumors."

"Some say the king of Rikistria had them stolen.
A lot of nonsense, too."
"I hope to find good gear again this time."
Something came up out of the dirt.

"What are you doing?
Get out of here."

"...You won't turn back...
Fine, take this.
It'll help when you run home."

"You're distracting me.
Don't talk to me."

"All I ever dig up is junk.
My instincts are terrible."

"You search the labyrinth.
Your instincts must be good."

"There's a square past the passage.
I once dug up a gem there."

"Want to dig for treasure yourself?
I'll lend you a tool."

"Treasure is buried in the labyrinth.
Some scholar says it has
a magical meaning."

"There's a square past the passage.
I dug up a gem there once.
Sloppy burial; I found it by luck..."

"They say the flames in the passage went out.
There's an uproar over there."

"Take my advice:
don't go any deeper."

"You spotted the trick in the wall.
Instincts like that suit a grave robber."

"This place is full of monsters.
It gets me down."

"It's the Plunderer King's
labyrinth, so there's treasure.
And how many died for it."

"There's treasure around here too.
Odd things buried, and so on."

"The post north of the entrance.

"I'll head back in a while.
Take care yourself."

"I think I can move now.
Here's the reward I promised."

"Oh, right,
I'll need that armband back."
"I'll kill the survivors of that mercenary band."

"If you don't want to meet a corpse,
stay quietly in town."

"I knew it. You mercenaries
can't be left to run loose."

"...What?

"Sorry, but your comrade here is my enemy."

If you don't want to see his corpse,
stay quietly in town."

"...What?
You don't mean to stop me, do you?"
